description: System invariants governing execution workspaces, worktree isolation, and queue state.

invariants.name: Ephemeral Runtime Isolation
invariants.quoted_invariant: All subdirectories and job artifacts in jobs/ are local runtime state and must never be committed to git.
invariants.rule: Exclude all execution directories, run spools, and intermediate outputs under jobs/ from repository commits.
invariants.drift_pattern: Accidentally checking in job workspace folders or local subprocess spools.

invariants.name: Worktree Isolation
invariants.quoted_invariant: Every agent execution session operates in a dedicated, isolated git worktree (.worktrees/ or session temporary directory). Open-heart surgery on repository checkouts is forbidden.
invariants.rule: Perform all executor modifications within isolated dedicated worktrees, preserving repository checkouts intact.
invariants.drift_pattern: Editing the active repository checkout directly during node implementation runs.

invariants.name: Database as Rebuildable Cache
invariants.quoted_invariant: Files are Truth: Durable files (GDDP_RECEIPTS_PATH, verdict YAMLs, git worktrees) constitute primary truth. The SQLite database (db/queue.db) is a rebuildable cache and index; nothing of architectural value is lost if queue.db is purged.
invariants.rule: Treat filesystem receipts and commit artifacts as primary evidence, treating queue.db as an index that can regenerate at will.
invariants.drift_pattern: Relying on database tables as the sole authority while omitting durable disk receipts.

invariants.name: Runtime Queue Separation from Graph Truth
invariants.quoted_invariant: Job completion in jobs/ updates job queue records in SQLite, never graph truth in gddp-config.
invariants.rule: Route job transitions through runtime queue state while preserving graph truth strictly for human modification.
invariants.drift_pattern: Attempting to update graph node statuses from executor completion handlers.
